reviews.classification: source-qualified grammar proposal and bounded mechanical derivation
reviews.disposition: Preserve G1.1–G8.4, GC1–GC12 and G-A–G-H with their original provenance. Derivable means a bounded note locator supports an authored structure, not full recipes, spell grammar or runtime implementation. Same hue has recipe/stage/modality context; diagnosis and improved instructions are attributed claims, improved cue is not proven potency, and repair does not restore lost contents. Acquired/read/practiced/executed are knowledge states, not interchangeable physical components of casting. Wandless/tool exceptions and recipe-local hard steps remain local, not universal gates. No private notes or raw novels were reread here; OCR/edition, missing quantities and source-set limits remain open.
reviews.evidence: Complete original report read in bounded ranges. Current selected contract and Hold Person target inspected for the named uncertainty only; no whole-source credit.
reviews.reopen: Selected grammar execution needs exact source rows, consumer and meaningful mismatch evidence; raw-source gaps remain scoped, not a new authorized reading wave.

reviews.classification: source-qualified grammar proposal and bounded mechanical derivation
reviews.disposition: Preserve F1–F5, ten traces, relation rows, seven golden cases and M1–M5 as a dated proposal with corrections. Current selected effect_dsl.js ranges 1–22 and 129–148 still show the inert, exact-key, edition/attribution-pinned contract; a sidecar remains a proposed way to preserve it, not evidence of an implemented consumer. Current spells.json 1005–1023 already types Hold Person as humanoid: close that narrow data-inspection gap, without claiming evaluator enforcement. M4’s listed level-3 average 28 and level-5 average 36 do not refute increasing damage with level; different scaling shapes suggest a question but are not the stated counterexample. Do not encode an expected-fail test on that unsupported conclusion. The tier-gap table and memory-only Dispel comparison are design suggestions, not an SRD-derived mixing law or a demonstrated source match. School labels and doesWhat hints do not supply effects. Full-list denominator 340, 6 percent coverage, work estimates and historical pack counts are not current verified totals; supplied text was not read. Preserve attribution and unknown semantics; no schema/runtime change or fresh gameplay proof.
